changes: Restored testintent_handoff as a formal PLAN-stage CLI command through MAIN_TOOLS, registry, and phase allowlist; narrowed evidence freshness metadata handling to Koala workflow metadata; added smoke scripts for freshness and handoff; documented the new freshness boundary and handoff command in requirements decisions.
usage: Run koala testintent_handoff --storyId=B-xxxx in PLAN to generate a test-intent handoff package. Run npm run test:verification-freshness-smoke and npm run test:testintent-handoff-smoke from packages/main to verify both regressions.
limitations: Evidence still intentionally becomes stale after material requirements, source, test, fixture, package, lockfile, or koala.config changes; historical evidence is not migrated.
pitfalls: Parallel checklist_update calls raced and dropped fields, so metadata writes should be sequential. Requirements documentation changes are material by design, so evidence must be refreshed after documenting freshness semantics.
